subtitle: 호텔에서 세탁 맡기기
desc: 호텔 프런트에 옷을 맡기고 세탁 시간과 가격을 확인하는 오후·저녁 회화

turns.speaker: You (Traveler)
turns.en: Good afternoon. Do you have a laundry service?

turns.speaker: Front Desk
turns.en: Yes, we do. Same-day or next-day service?

turns.speaker: You (Traveler)
turns.en: Same-day if possible. I need these shirts for tomorrow.
turns.ko: 가능하면 당일로 부탁해요. 내일 입을 셔츠들이에요.

turns.speaker: Front Desk
turns.en: Same-day is available until four p.m. After that it is next-day.
turns.ko: 당일 서비스는 오후 4시까지 가능합니다. 그 이후는 다음날이에요.

turns.speaker: You (Traveler)
turns.en: It is three now, so same-day is fine. How much does it cost?

turns.speaker: Front Desk
turns.en: Shirts are eight dollars each. Pants are twelve. We also do dry cleaning.

turns.speaker: You (Traveler)
turns.en: Three shirts and one pair of pants, please. When will they be ready?
turns.ko: 셔츠 세 장과 바지 한 벌 부탁합니다. 언제 받을 수 있나요?

turns.speaker: Front Desk
turns.en: They will be ready by eight this evening. We can deliver them to your room.
turns.ko: 오늘 저녁 8시까지 준비됩니다. 객실로 배달해 드릴 수 있어요.

turns.speaker: You (Traveler)
turns.en: Perfect. Room 815. Can I pay when they are delivered?

turns.speaker: Front Desk
turns.en: Yes. Just sign the form and leave the bag at the desk. Have a nice afternoon.
turns.ko: 네. 양식에 서명하시고 가방을 데스크에 두시면 됩니다. 좋은 오후 되세요.

tips.en: Do you have a laundry service?
Can I pay when they are delivered?
